name: broadcast-intercom
description: Prototype for mixed DECT and PoE beltpack intercom system

scripts.dev: npm run kill-ports && concurrently -n server,web -c green,blue "npm:dev:server" "npm:dev:web"
scripts.dev:mock: npm run kill-ports && concurrently -n server,web -c green,blue "cross-env MOCK_DEVICES=1 npm run dev -w @broadcast/server" "npm:dev:web"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @broadcast/shared && npm run build -w @broadcast/server && npm run build -w @broadcast/web
